name: Death research institute
source:
A short visual novel from the first person. The scene is an abandoned Soviet Research Institute. Try to find out if this is reality, hallucinations or mysticism?

[From [url=https://evalancelot.itch.io/death-research-institute]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部第一人稱短篇視覺小說，舞臺是一座廢棄的蘇聯研究所。試著弄明白，你所經歷的究竟是現實、幻覺，還是超自然現象？

［摘自[url=https://evalancelot.itch.io/death-research-institute]itch.io[/url]］
